mapper.select: SELECT 'start' AS target, description AS text, voice_mode, voice_file_path, voice_content_type, voice_script_outdated FROM financial_patterns WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND financial_pattern_id = #{patternId} AND is_active = TRUE UNION ALL SELECT ps.step_code AS target, ps.instruction_text AS text, ps.voice_mode, ps.voice_file_path, ps.voice_content_type, ps.voice_script_outdated FROM pattern_steps ps JOIN financial_patterns fp USING (financial_pattern_id) WHERE fp.user_id = #{userId} AND fp.financial_pattern_id = #{patternId} AND fp.is_active = TRUE AND ps.step_code != 'TRANSFER_COMPLETE'

choose.when: UPDATE financial_patterns SET voice_script_outdated = voice_script_outdated OR (voice_file_path IS NOT NULL AND BINARY description != BINARY #{text}), description = #{text}, voice_mode = #{voiceMode} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND financial_pattern_id = #{patternId} AND is_active = TRUE

UPDATE financial_patterns SET voice_file_path = #{filePath}, voice_content_type = #{contentType}, voice_script_outdated = FALSE WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND financial_pattern_id = #{patternId} AND is_active = TRUE
